messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Wow. I didn't think it would
be this hard to find a
fossil, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0f 00}I mean, aren't they just, 
like, lying around?{01 00 00 0a 00} It's not
like you have to CATCH 'EM.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Vau. Ma ei arvanud, et
fossiili on nii raske
leida, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0f 00}Ma mõtlen, kas nad ei
vedele maas?{01 00 00 0a 00} Pole ju nii,
et pead neid PÜÜDMA.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I don't CARE which fossil!
Just find one!{01 00 00 05 00} ANY ONE!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Get me some old bones!
{07 06 00}Getting fossils is my first
step towards fame and
fortune, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Mind EI huvita, kui fossiil!
Lihtsalt leia üks!{01 00 00 05 00} ÜKSKÕIK
MILLINE!{01 00 00 0a 00} Too mulle vanu
konte! {07 06 00}Fossiilide saamine on
mu esimene samm kuulsuse
varanduse poole, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
